in_marathi.name: Kamraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Black Magic
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamraj is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, associated with the Hindu deity Kamadeva, the god of desire and love. The name Kamraj refers to the power or influence of Kamadeva, the enchanting and mystical power of love.
